about_the_game:
🐾 Pet Rescue Adventure

Vaporize robots, rescue pets, and lead an interplanetary uprising in this hilarious sci-fi shooter with heart.

Pet shop owner Rose thought her biggest problem was finding homes for rescue animals… until alien robots started abducting Earth’s pets for bizarre “love research.” These invaders—bureaucratic machines from the distant world of Kolvaris—run their empire like a soul-crushing corporation, complete with middle-manager bots, employee write-ups, and a ruthless CEO known only as the Planet Admin. Their goal? Learn why humans adore their pets… and use that secret to enslave humanity.

🧠 STORY & WORLD

  • Fight back as Rose, an unlikely hero who teams up with a hyper-intelligent Bengal cat named Cookie, a sarcastic squirrel named P’Nut, and a few other misfit allies.

  • Explore a city full of satirical billboards, weird products, and graffiti clues that hide easter-egg treasure hunts.

  • Discover the robot hierarchy—from disposable Grunts to scheming Regional Managers, all clawing for promotion in a corrupt, machine-run bureaucracy.

  • Uncover the mystery of Earth’s Planet Admin, a shadowy figure possibly hiding in plain sight among world leaders.

🔫 GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Hybrid First- & Third-Person Shooter: Switch between perspectives anytime as you raid robot facilities, blast mechanical enemies, and free captured animals.

  • Pet Rescue Missions: Save hundreds of pets—from golden retrievers to snakes, chameleons, armadillos, and even the legendary Pet Rock. Each rescued companion unlocks new lore, collectibles, or silly rewards.

  • Playable Pets: Take control of special animals like Cookie the cat, Percy the parrot, or P’Nut the squirrel for stealth, flight, or chaotic driving sequences.

  • Weapons & Gadgets: Use plasma rifles, EMP grenades, “gas weasels,” and other ridiculous contraptions to turn invaders into scrap metal.

  • Exploration & Secrets: Roam a living city full of shops, easter eggs, and dynamic ads—some real, some hilariously fake.

  • Mini-Games & The Arcade: Earn XP and unlock side games ranging from retro shooter challenges to claw-machine chaos.

🧩 TONE & STYLE

Pet Rescue Adventure blends comedy, satire, and genuine affection for animals. Expect over-the-top action, movie-style chases (like a squirrel car chase gone nuclear from one acorn), witty dialogue, and a world packed with absurd detail—from robot janitors questioning their existence to perfume ads for “Boiled Ham Edition.”

Save the pets. Expose the robots. And remind the universe why humanity’s greatest strength… is loving something small and fuzzy.

Minimum:
  • OS *: Win 7
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580 (6 GB VRAM recommended)
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: After uncovering an alien plot to wipe out humanity, pet shop owner Rose and a hyper-intelligent Bengal cat lead a hilarious interplanetary rebellion. Blast robots, rescue pets, and fight for Earth in this chaotic sci-fi action adventure!
